notes: A national occupational standard, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
Stores the 13 competency units only; curriculum modules and hours are not stored and no overall course duration is stated.
Revision 2 of M80S001 was titled 'PRESCHOOL TEACHER (Early Childhood Development)', the same as the NYSC course; revision 4 (July 2026) is titled 'Early Childhood Care and Development Teacher'.

The source is internally inconsistent: the unit list and page-7 packaging contain U01-U11, BU01 and BU02, while the endorsement page package also lists 'M80S001U12', which is not defined in the unit list.
The revision page spells 'Forth Revision July 2026'; the wording is kept as published.
scope_verbatim: National Certificate at NVQ Level 04 in the occupation of Early Childhood Care and Development Teacher will be awarded to those who are competent in units U01+ U02+ U03+ U04+ U05+ U06+ U07+ U08+ U09+ U10+ U11+ BU01+ BU02– M80S001Q1L4

records.institution: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
records.duration_as_published: One Year (1200 Hours + 150 OJT/ Group Project)
records.entry_as_published: Passed 10th class examination. Minimum Age 14 years as on first day of academic session.

modules.title_verbatim: Develop growth and development of 0-6years old Physical, language, social, emotional, cognitive, fine motor development, gross motor following safety precautions.
Analyze Philosophies of Early Childhood Educationist Maria Montessori, Fedrick Forbel, Jean Piaget, Rudolf Stiener, Reggio Emilia.
Apply the knowledge to prepare an Inside – Outside Environment for Pre-School Health and Safety of Pre-School children First Aid.
Identify the development of Practical Life and Sensorial Lesson in Pre-School.
Select and execute the Progression and Presentation of Language and Math Skills in Early Childhood.
Select and apply the Art, Craft Music in Early Childhood to build concentration and calmness, realizing of feelings and developing balancing control movements to reach their full potential.

Comprehend Physical Science, Life Science, Botany, Zoology and Geography, Creating awareness and sensitivity of the world around us, making rational conclusions, being respectful of other cultures and communities.
Apply life skills and conflict resolution through Positive Discipline. Increase awareness of self, others and the environment.
